responsibility: Implements AVR-specific GCC driver spec functions that run before the compiler proper and linker are invoked. It validates and normalizes `-mmcu` handling to select the appropriate per-device specs file, filters malformed or repeated MCU selections, strips no-op device-library options when appropriate, and reconstructs coherent `-mdouble=` and `-mlong-double=` option combinations so the driver passes a consistent floating-type multilib configuration to subtools.
